summary.name: faun.dev
summary.one_liner: FAUN.dev is the site behind DevOpsLinks, a weekly newsletter about SRE, SysAdmin and DevOps news, tools, tutorials and opinions, but the fetched page was only a Cloudflare security block message.
use_cases: Keeping up with weekly SRE and DevOps news
Finding DevOps tutorials and tool announcements
summary.what_it_does: The fetched page is a Cloudflare 'Sorry, you have been blocked' security message, so no site content was visible. It says the block is triggered by actions such as submitting certain words or phrases, SQL commands or malformed data, and suggests emailing the site owner with the Cloudflare Ray ID. From the awesome-sre listing, the site hosts DevOpsLinks, a weekly newsletter covering SRE, SysAdmin and DevOps news, tools, tutorials and opinions. The page itself does not describe any features.
